P.name: Draw a Bead
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' and ''{{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}}'' gain {{sti|attack range|{{pp|0 + (150-0)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' range}}, for a total of {{pp|{{ccd|Tristana|range}}+0 + ({{ccd|Tristana|range}}+150-{{ccd|Tristana|range}})/17*(x-1) for 20}}.

Q.name: Rapid Fire
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' empowers her cannon, gaining {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 7 seconds.

W.name: Rocket Jump
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' {{tip|dash|jumps}} to the target location. Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
W.description2: Scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonating ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at maximum stacks on a champion will reset ''Rocket Jump's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
W.description3: '''''Tristana''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

E.name: Explosive Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tristana's''' basic attacks are empowered to trigger an explosion when they kill the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' tosses an explosive charge at the target enemy that attaches to them for 4 seconds. The charge then detonates, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. ''Explosive Charge'' can target and damage {{tip|turrets}}, and explodes in a larger radius on a turret.
E.description3: '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against the target increase ''Explosive Charge's'' damage by {{ap|0.25*100}}%, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 4 times for a maximum {{ap|0.25*400}}% increase, upon which the charge also detonates instantly. The charge's '''total''' damage is additionally increased by {{critical damage|0 to 40|critScaling=true}}.
E.description4: ''If {{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}} is used to apply the last stack, the detonation will instead be delayed until the end of the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} or the 4 seconds expire.''
E.cast time: {{as|100% of '''Tristana's''' windup time|as}} ({{fd|{{#expr:(1/{{ccd|Tristana|as_base}})*{{ccd|Tristana|windup}}round2}}}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

R.name: Buster Shot
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' fires a massive cannonball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. They and surrounding enemies are also {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration, during which all targets are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
